description: This file defines the DetailView class, which extends ListView and handles the display and navigation of detailed records in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for processing individual data beans, managing navigation controls, and maintaining session variables related to record views.

classes.name: DetailView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering detailed views of records, managing navigation controls, and interacting with session data and external components within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DetailView object and calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: processSugarBean
methods.description: Processes a SugarBean object to retrieve detailed record information, handle navigation, and manage session variables for record views.

methods.name: populateQueryWhere
methods.description: Sets the query where clause for retrieving record details based on the view context and session variables.

methods.name: processListNavigation
methods.description: Generates HTML for navigation controls (pagination, previous/next buttons, audit logs) in the detail view, and manages navigation state.

methods.name: set_base_URL
methods.description: Sets the base URL for navigation links based on current GET/POST parameters.

methods.name: setListViewRowCount
methods.description: Sets the number of rows in the ListView for pagination purposes.

methods.name: getListViewRowCount
methods.description: Retrieves the current number of ListView rows.

methods.name: isRequestFromListView
methods.description: Determines if the current request originated from a list view, based on session variables and request parameters.

methods.name: getVariableFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves a session variable related to the list view.
